title: Resident Evil
provenance: Reported by Themio1998 (upstream#252, 2026-09-29), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, KLYC-Box 0.9.39, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r11, D3DMetal, DLL overrides as typed version=n,b;winmm-n,b;dinput8=n,b, recipes steam and vcrun2022, rated 4 of 5 after 3 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: The 2015 HD Remaster of the 2002 remake. Reported playable on D3DMetal on an M1 with the default engine r11 after a three-minute session, with a smooth frame rate by the reporter's account. DXMT and DXVK were not tried. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: A pause the first time a door animation or the menu loads, quick after that (reported).
knownIssues.cause: most likely shaders compiling on first use, not measured here.
knownIssues.fix: none needed, it goes away after the first time.

knownIssues.symptom: Minor graphical glitches during door animations and in some locations (reported on D3DMetal).
knownIssues.cause: not looked at here, the reporter suspects the graphics mode.
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed. DXMT is the other mode to try.
